status: proposed by the FR-7 lane owner for the lead's check, 2026-11-19; numbers only (no code), for R-loop's code-blind references (D231: the reference sits on the world the probe measured)
synthetic: every value marked synthetic is this world's own synthetic choice (D217); the heredity cell H's declared values are the engine's fixture values, then scaled as stated

population.conductance: P N / rho_ref (m^3/s), the view's P a A with a = N / (A rho_ref)
population.note: phi = 1: P N0/rho_ref equals the heredity cell's declared Na leak P A (5.3333e-11 m/s x A)

producer.removal_note: k_r acts on all of N, the declared N0 included; maturing units are not removed (D232)
producer.stages_note: m = 0: units enter N directly. m = 3 with kappa = 0.1/s (R-chain's) is the alternative once the producer can declare initial maturation pools, the same engine gap as R-chain's W5; the lead's choice

precursor.species: a neutral cytosolic species (D150's inventory form)
precursor.regime: held: a supply S_P and a fast first-order clearance k_P under D150's turnover, so n_P relaxes in about 1 s to S_P/(k_P + k_a F) and the units' sensitivity to F, k_P/(k_P + k_a F), is at least 0.987 at any F (0.9974 at the start)
precursor.computed: n0 and the supply S_P are not given: the references compute it from the declared inputs (the closed loop's own steady state with no template, N = N0); the references' registered value is the start both sides use, as for A5''. The precursor is held: its supply balances the producer's uptake and its clearance at the start.

start_balance.note: c_u k_a F_T F_loop n_P = k_r N0 at the start, with F_T = b_T (no template before the dose) and F_loop = 1 - s*; m = 0, so no maturing stage

constants.note: exact SI (2019), as the engine uses them

setting.note: D231 as the lead registered it: scale 100 (ions relax in about 50 s), phi = 1 (the units carry the cell's whole Na leak), the held precursor

cell.M_and_P: M is a permeant monovalent anion; P is an impermeant monovalent anion (permeability 0)

patch.leak_note: phi = 1: the patch's declared Na leak, 5.3333333333333356e-11 m/s, is carried entirely by the Na-leak units, so the patch keeps no Na leak

state_H_scaled.note: the declared state H divided by the scale. It is NOT the start: the start is protocol.start_state

stoichiometry.note: 3 Na out, 2 K in per cycle

fuel.note: the hydrolysis drive is dG0 + R T ln(ADP Pi / (ATP x 1 M)), with the pools in mM over the 1 M standard state

pump.alpha: not a declared parameter of this law; its declared values are those above
pump.unchanged_by_scale: capacity, Km, pools and dG0 are as the heredity cell declares them
pump.provenance: the declared values (capacity, Km, pools, dG0, availability) are the heredity cell's declaration; the saturation orders (3, 2, 1) and the 1 M standard state are the law's own constants (its source), not declared values

state.s0_note: the state's steady value at the start's Na_i: s* = k_on u/(k_on u + k_off), u = Na^n/(K^n + Na^n)
state.computed: s0 is not given: the references compute it from the declared inputs (the closed loop's own steady state with no template, N = N0); the references' registered value is the start both sides use, as for A5''

route.target: the producer's assembly rate k_a (B1', target_half_steps), operating range [0, 1] of the state's fraction
route.computed: F_loop0 = 1 - s0 is not given: the references compute it from the declared inputs (the closed loop's own steady state with no template, N = N0); the references' registered value is the start both sides use, as for A5''

regulator_and_route.with_the_template: both routes stand on the same element (the route naleak_units) of the producer's assembly rate, so the effective rate is k_a x F_T x F_loop, the product in declared order (the template's coupling first), each evaluated at the start of each of the producer's half-steps from the state that half-step receives

template.intent: R-chain's template (validation/fr7/references/interface/inputs.json: the dose concentration 0.1 mM, K 0.01 mM, n 2, half-life 20 s, epsilon 2e-6), with one departure: basal b_T = 0.2 instead of R-chain's 0.02
template.species: a neutral cytosolic species under D150's turnover (no membrane route)

factor.factor: F_T = b + (1 - b) c^n/(K^n + c^n), c = n_T/V

template.operating_range_note: proposed [0, 1] mM rather than R-chain's registered [1e-7, 1]: the engine refuses a routed half-step whose enabled source leaves its declared range, and the template falls below 1e-7 mM at about 399 s, inside this horizon; the factor is b exactly at c = 0. Pending the lead's ruling (the same point arises in R-chain's worlds)
template.basal_note: b_T = 0.2 (synthetic) is chosen so the dose keeps N within a few N0 and the pump within its reserve; R-chain's b = 0.02 would multiply assembly about 50-fold and drive N far beyond, past the pump's reserve. The references compute the actual excursion.

protocol.start: the closed loop's own steady state with no template (F_T = b): the cell at its stationary state with N = N0, s = s*, n_P, M* and N0 balanced; the template's dose at t = 0

start_state.definition: the closed loop's own steady state with no template (c = 0) and N = N0: not given: the references compute it from the declared inputs (the closed loop's own steady state with no template, N = N0); the references' registered value is the start both sides use, as for A5''
start_state.state_H_is_not_the_start: the declared state H (cell.state_H_scaled) is the fixture's initial composition; the start is this stationary state of the same cell with N = N0

protocol.t_d_note: the cut control's time: the registered t_clear of R-chain's dose worlds (260 s), which this template's concentration trajectory shares (the same c(t) = 0.1 mM 2^(-t/20 s), K, n and epsilon 2e-6)
protocol.cut_control: the lead's accepted form: from t_d the loop's coupling is switched off (F_loop exactly 1) and the producer's scheduled k_a is stepped to k_a F*, F* the engine's own applied loop factor from the coupling's record at the closed arm's row t_d, at the same dt
protocol.horizon_note: t_clear plus five unit half-lives (5 x 60 s)
protocol.rows_note: R-chain's grid: 0, 1, 2 and 5 s, then every 10 s to the horizon
protocol.cut_control_F_star_note: The references take F* from their own closed trajectory at t_d. The engine takes its own applied factor, which lags by up to half a step; the protocol registers a bound on |F*_engine - F*_reference| that covers that lag.

relayed_by_lead: 2026-11-19: the lead removed the values the engine computed (the start, s0, F_loop0, the precursor's n0 and supply) and the engine-side provenance paths; every remaining number is a declared input
